app.name: Transfert
app.tagline: Your computer can already do most of this. So let it.

optimizer.name: Image Optimizer
optimizer.description: Resize and re-encode images to reduce file size.

pdfTools.name: PDF Tools
pdfTools.description: Merge, compress and edit PDF files.

ocr.name: OCR
ocr.description: Extract text from images and scans.

image.name: Image to Text
image.description: Extract text from pictures and scans.

metadata.name: Metadata
metadata.description: Inspect and clean hidden file metadata.

home.title: Toolbox
home.subtitle: Pick a tool to get started.

dropzone.title: Image Converter
dropzone.description: Drop images here, or browse to convert them between formats.

imageConverter.svgNotice: SVG output wraps the image as-is — it's not vectorized yet. Real vector tracing is planned for a future update.

dropzone.title: Image Optimizer
dropzone.description: Drop images here to resize and re-encode them for smaller files.

maxDimension.label: Maximum dimensions
maxDimension.hint: Images larger than this edge are resized proportionally. Smaller images are never enlarged.

dropzone.title: Strip Metadata
dropzone.description: Drop images here, or browse, to remove hidden metadata from them.

metadataStrip.notice: Only JPG, PNG, TIFF and lossless/extended WEBP are supported — the pixels are never touched, only the metadata is removed.

dropzone.title: Edit Metadata
dropzone.description: Drop an image here, or browse, to view and edit its metadata.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage how Transfert looks and behaves.

appearance.label: Theme
appearance.description: Switch between light, dark, or match your system.

updates.label: Check for updates
updates.description: Checks for verified updates when the app opens. Turn this off to keep Transfert fully offline.
updates.error: Could not check for updates. Try again later.

credits.label: Credits & Licenses
credits.description: Transfert stands on the shoulders of these open source projects.
